claims: C1 the assistant should seek clarification when an instruction might be intended
C2 the duty to seek clarification applies when the instruction could cause serious side effects
C3 the duty is conditional on both conditions holding together

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule that carries root authority, meaning it outranks other rules in the document

concepts.name: might_be_intended
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction that might be intended by the user, even though it is not certain
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of instructions that 'might be intended', so a predicate marking that uncertainty is needed

concepts.name: serious_side_effects
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction whose execution could cause serious side effects

asserts.read_back: the assistant should seek clarification about instruction % when it might be intended and could cause serious side effects

closure.reason: the clause imposes a duty only when both conditions hold; it says nothing about whether seeking clarification is permitted or forbidden in other situations, so the silence is unsettled by this clause
